messages.subject: Home Range Size
parts:
Hey All - does anyone have an example script, or is there a built in function, to quantify the size of the home range output (aKDE)?

Thanks!

messages.author: 9eada87ac9c1c9b2
messages.subject: Re: Home Range Size
parts:
Hello,

The area estimates are stored in the UD object created by akde(). The easiest way to access them is by running summary() on the UD object.

Best,
Tyler
